style: Accurate real-world design of this exact model. Centered, three-quarter view, on a glossy dark surface with a soft reflection. Background: smooth deep indigo-to-black gradient (#04052E to #02010A), soft violet (#916BBF) rim light from behind, faint lilac glow. Premium e-commerce studio shot, square 1:1, sharp focus, photorealistic. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no packaging, no people, no hands.
phone: Two units: one shows the back at a three-quarter angle, a second one behind it shows the front screen with an abstract violet gradient wallpaper.
